classes.BP_PE_Character: The player character (third-person template child). Holds health, carried matter, the tool inventory (Gun, Extractor, Constructor), the build preview, ship-turret / scout control, the jetpack, death + respawn and the gradual unloading of matter at the ship. Most input arrives as parameterless 'Run on Server' events (SRV_*) that call the Server* functions; local-only logic (jetpack key polling, hover, prompts, audio) runs in ExtraTick/InteractTick.
classes.BP_PE_PlayerController: Player controller. Owns the HUD widget, the pause menu, the keyboard layout (AZERTY/QWERTY input mapping contexts) and the loaded player settings (mouse sensitivity, invert Y, jetpack key).
classes.BP_PE_GameMode: Game mode for gameplay maps. On BeginPlay makes sure a BP_MapGenerator exists, then spawns BP_Spawning and applies URL options (SetupTime, HordeInterval, FirstHorde, HordeIncrement, ...).
classes.BP_PlayerSettingsSave: SaveGame object stored in slot 'PlayerSettings': MouseSensitivity, bUseAzerty, bInvertY, JetpackKey.
classes.BP_MenuGameMode: Game mode of the main-menu map (Lvl_MainMenu). Empty.
classes.BP_MenuPlayerController: Main-menu controller: creates WBP_MainMenu, shows the cursor and switches to UI-only input.
classes.BP_MapGenerator: Level generator placed in / spawned for each map. Server picks (or reads from the URL option 'Seed') a replicated seed, spawns the ship at the origin, spawns replicated matter sources, and every machine generates the non-replicated decor (trees, rocks, plants) locally from the same seed. Projects spawn points onto the ground with a trace.
classes.BP_Spawning: Monster horde spawner. Schedules hordes (SetupTime, TimeBetweenHordes, FirstHordeSize + HordeIncrement * index, NumberOfHordes), spawns monsters at random points on the map edge and replicates CurrentHorde so every client plays the ship siren on each new horde.
classes.BP_Monster: Enemy character. Chases an objective (a random player or the ship) every tick, attacks on hit (TryAttack with cooldown), has health and dies when it reaches 0.
classes.BP_Tool: Base class of hand tools. Stores name/power/range/use-rate/mesh/beam settings, the owning character and the replicated bIsUsing flag. Provides the beam visual (ShowBeam/HideBeam) for children.
classes.BP_Gun: Hitscan gun tool. Fires at the camera crosshair on a timer while the trigger is held, replicates the last shot end point and flashes a beam.
classes.BP_Extractor: Matter extractor tool. Locks the nearest matter source(s) in range and moves matter into the player's carried stock each tick. Upgrades with TotalMatterExtracted: every UpgradeStep (200) gives +30% rate, +30% range and +10 player max matter; at 1000 it extracts from 2 sources at once. Shows its stats on the HUD and loops extract.wav while working.
classes.BP_Constructor: Build tool. Cycles through buildables (Barrier, Turret), computes a valid placement from the player's aim, spawns the buildable, charges its matter cost and replicates it.
classes.BP_Buildable: Base class of player-built structures: cost, resistance (health), preview mode (ghost material + no collision) and replication once the real structure is placed.
classes.BP_Barrier: Simple wall buildable. Only inherits BP_Buildable behaviour.
classes.BP_Turret: Automatic defence turret (buildable). Every 0.1 s acquires the nearest monster in FireRange, aims its head and fires a laser shot. Gains XP per shot; at the XP threshold it becomes 'ready to upgrade', the player pays matter with E to level up (max level 5: +damage, +range, +15% size). A floating label shows level and a 3D XP bar.
classes.BP_EnvironmentElement: Base class for world objects with a mesh and a replicated-from-seed look (trees, rocks, plants, matter sources).
classes.BP_MatterSource: Harvestable matter block. Holds InitialMatter/RemainingMatter (replicated), shrinks as it is mined, has a solid BlockAll collider and is destroyed when empty.
classes.BP_Ship: The player's ship: matter tank (MatterGoal), hull, deposit zone, takeoff when the tank is full and game-lost when the hull reaches 0. Spawns the static ship turret and the scout ship at BeginPlay and plays the horde siren.
classes.BP_ShipTurret: Player-operated heavy turret on the ship with 3 modes (burst, cannon, laser). The operator's camera direction aims it; shells and the laser leave from a virtual nozzle in front of the mesh. Costs matter from the ship tank. Plays canon.wav per shell and loops laser.wav.
classes.BP_ScoutShip: Small controllable flying turret (child of BP_ShipTurret). Takes off when a player boards, flies a circle around the ship (FlightHeight, FlightRadius, SpeedMultiplier x player speed), burns MatterPerSecond from the ship tank for up to MaxFlightTime seconds, returns and recharges when docked. Position is replicated manually and smoothed on clients.
classes.BP_TurretShell: Projectile fired by the ship turret. Launched in local space, explodes on hit (area damage to monsters) and plays the cannon sound once on every machine.
classes.WBP_HUD: In-game HUD: tool name, extractor info lines, matter, health, ship tank/hull, status, turret status, wave info, crosshair, hint and interaction prompt. Updated every tick.
classes.WBP_MainMenu: Main menu: lists every Lvl_* map found in /Game/PlanetEscape/Maps, then Solo (open map), Host (open map?listen) or Join (open ip) and opens Options.
classes.WBP_Options: Options screen: layout, sensitivity, invert Y, jetpack key selector, display/graphics presets and quality settings. Changes apply and save immediately.
classes.WBP_PauseMenu: Pause menu (Esc / P): Resume, Options, Quit/Disconnect.

functions.BP_PE_Character.OnRep_Tools: RepNotify of the Tools array (client side refresh hook).
functions.BP_PE_Character.OnRep_ActiveToolIndex: RepNotify when the equipped tool changes; refreshes which tool actor is visible.
functions.BP_PE_Character.AddMatter: Adds matter to the carried stock, clamped to MaxMatter. Returns the amount really accepted.
functions.BP_PE_Character.GetActiveTool: Returns the tool actor at ActiveToolIndex.
functions.BP_PE_Character.RefreshToolVisibility: Server: shows only the active tool actor, hides the others.
functions.BP_PE_Character.SpawnTools: Server, BeginPlay: spawns Gun, Extractor and Constructor, attaches them to the tool socket, registers them in Tools.
functions.BP_PE_Character.SetActiveTool: Stops the current tool, switches ActiveToolIndex (notifies) and refreshes visibility.
functions.BP_PE_Character.HandleSwitchTool: Mouse-wheel handler: in build mode cycles buildables, otherwise cycles tools (via server events).
functions.BP_PE_Character.TryPayMatter: Pays a cost first from carried matter, then from the ship tank. Returns true if paid.
functions.BP_PE_Character.CanAfford: True if carried matter or the ship tank can cover Cost.
functions.BP_PE_Character.StartBuildPreview: Enters build mode when the Constructor is equipped.
functions.BP_PE_Character.StopBuildPreview: Leaves build mode and destroys the preview.
functions.BP_PE_Character.FinishBuild: On build input: asks the server to place the previewed buildable.
functions.BP_PE_Character.BuildTick: Local tick: keeps the preview actor existing and positioned while in build mode.
functions.BP_PE_Character.EnsurePreview: Creates (or recreates when the selection changes) the ghost buildable used as preview.
functions.BP_PE_Character.PositionPreview: Moves the ghost to the computed placement and tints it valid/invalid (affordable and free).
functions.BP_PE_Character.ServerBuild: Server: calls Constructor.Build for the active tool.
functions.BP_PE_Character.DestroyPreview: Destroys the preview actor if any.
functions.BP_PE_Character.TakeHit: Server damage entry. Ignored while in a turret or already dead; reduces Health and calls Die at 0.
functions.BP_PE_Character.CanUseTurret: True if the ship turret / scout is free, within InteractRange and in front of the player.
functions.BP_PE_Character.EnterTurret: Boards a ship turret or scout: sets operator, disables movement/collision, hides the character and tools, attaches to the seat.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ExitTurret: Leaves the turret: clears operator, detaches, teleports to the exit point, restores movement and visibility.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ServerInteract: Server handler of E. Priority: (in turret) exit / scout return, enter a usable turret, upgrade a ready turret, otherwise toggle matter unloading. Ignored while dead.
functions.BP_PE_Character.DepositToShip: Legacy instant deposit of all carried matter (replaced by ToggleDeposit/DepositTick).
functions.BP_PE_Character.ServerStartUse: Server: starts firing the turret or using the active tool. Ignored while dead.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ServerStopUse: Server: stops turret fire or the active tool.
functions.BP_PE_Character.InteractTick: Every tick (called from the EventGraph): runs ExtraTick, then on the local player updates the interaction prompt (respawn countdown, turret, upgrade, unload).
functions.BP_PE_Character.ApplyAim: Applies mouse look to the controller with the saved sensitivity and invert-Y setting.
functions.BP_PE_Character.FindUpgradableTurret: Returns the BP_Turret within reach that is ready to upgrade, if any.
functions.BP_PE_Character.FindUsableTurret: Returns the first ship turret or scout the player can board.
functions.BP_PE_Character.OnRep_bJetpackActive: RepNotify: applies the flying/falling movement mode on every machine.
functions.BP_PE_Character.MakeSoundComp: Creates an audio component with spatial attenuation overrides for the given sound.
functions.BP_PE_Character.UpdateAudio: Every machine: plays run.wav while moving on the ground without jetpack, loops jetpack.wav while the jetpack is active.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ApplyJetpackMode: Switches the character movement to Flying (MaxFlySpeed = MoveSpeed x (1+JetpackSpeedBonus)) or back to Falling.
functions.BP_PE_Character.JetpackServerOn: Server (via SRV_JetpackOn): activates the jetpack if carried matter > 0, not in a turret and not dead.
functions.BP_PE_Character.JetpackLocal: Local player: polls the configured jetpack key, sends SRV_JetpackOn/Off on key changes and keeps the character JetpackHoverHeight above the ground by feeding vertical movement input.
functions.BP_PE_Character.JetpackServerTick: Server: burns JetpackConsumption matter per second from CarriedMatter while active and switches the jetpack off at 0.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ExtraTick: Per-tick hub: audio, local jetpack logic, server jetpack consumption and gradual deposit.
functions.BP_PE_Character.OnRep_bDead: RepNotify of bDead: applies the dead/alive visual and movement state.
functions.BP_PE_Character.Die: Server: marks the player dead, stops jetpack/tools/deposit, optionally loses carried matter (bLoseMatterOnDeath), increments DeathCount and schedules Respawn after RespawnDelayPerDeath x DeathCount seconds.
functions.BP_PE_Character.Respawn: Server: restores health, clears bDead and teleports the player next to the ship.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ApplyDeadState: Hides the character, disables collision and movement when dead; restores them when alive.
functions.BP_PE_Character.ToggleDeposit: Server: starts/stops gradual unloading when the player is in the ship deposit range and carries matter.
functions.BP_PE_Character.DepositTick: Server: while unloading moves DepositRate (50) matter per second from the player to the ship tank, stopping when empty, out of range or full.
functions.BP_PE_Character.CanJumpInternal: Engine override hook for jump permission.
functions.BP_PE_PlayerController.ApplyInputMapping: Removes all input mapping contexts and adds the AZERTY or QWERTY one.
functions.BP_PE_PlayerController.SetKeyboardLayout: Stores the layout and reapplies the mapping.
functions.BP_PE_PlayerController.ReloadPlayerSetti: Loads the PlayerSettings save (sensitivity, invert Y, layout, jetpack key) into the controller and reapplies mappings.
functions.BP_PE_PlayerController.TogglePauseMenu: Opens or closes the pause menu.
functions.BP_PE_PlayerController.OpenPauseMenu: Creates the pause widget, shows the cursor and ignores look/move input.
functions.BP_PE_PlayerController.ClosePauseMenu: Removes pause/options widgets and restores game input.
functions.BP_PE_GameMode.SpawnSpawning: Spawns BP_Spawning and applies the URL options to its variables.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.OnRep_Seed: On clients, generates the local decor once the seed has replicated.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.GenerateDecor: Spawns trees, rocks and plants (NumTrees/NumRocks/NumPlants) on the ground using a seeded random stream, so all machines get the same decor.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.GenerateMatter: Server: spawns NumMatterSources matter blocks with a size biased by distance from the map centre.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.SpawnShip: Server: spawns BP_Ship on the ground at the map origin.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.RandomMapPoint: Random point inside the map, pushed outside the safe radius around the ship.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.MakeDecorTransform: Random decor transform: random point, yaw and scale 0.7-1.4.
functions.BP_MapGenerator.ProjectToGround: Line trace from above to find the ground; returns hit location and validity (slope limit).
functions.BP_Spawning.ScheduleFirstHorde: Initialises horde counters and starts the timer for the first horde after SetupTime.
functions.BP_Spawning.SpawnHorde: Spawns NextHordeSize monsters, increments CurrentHorde (replicated, triggers the siren) and schedules the next horde.
functions.BP_Spawning.SpawnOneMonster: Spawns one monster at a random edge point projected on the ground.
functions.BP_Spawning.RandomEdgePoint: Random point on one of the four map edges, inset by EdgeInset.
functions.BP_Spawning.OnRep_CurrentHorde: RepNotify: each new horde (CurrentHorde >= 1) plays the ship siren on this machine.
functions.BP_Monster.ChaseTick: Server: walks toward the objective; picks a new objective if invalid.
functions.BP_Monster.PickObjective: Randomly selects a player character or, by default, the ship.
functions.BP_Monster.TryAttack: On hit of a character or the ship, applies Damage if the attack cooldown has elapsed.
functions.BP_Tool.OnRep_bIsUsing: RepNotify: hides the beam when the tool stops being used.
functions.BP_Tool.ShowBeam: Places and scales the beam mesh between two points and shows it.
functions.BP_Gun.OnRep_LastShotEnd: Clients: draws the beam to the replicated shot end point for a short time.
functions.BP_Gun.Fire: Traces from the camera to the crosshair, applies damage and records the shot end point.
functions.BP_Extractor.ExtractTick: Server tick while in use: picks up to GetMaxSources sources, removes rate-scaled matter from each, adds it to the player, adds to TotalMatterExtracted and grants +MatterCapacityPerStep max matter per newly reached upgrade step.
functions.BP_Extractor.GetBonusSteps: Number of completed upgrade steps = floor(TotalMatterExtracted / UpgradeStep).
functions.BP_Extractor.GetEffectiveRange: Tool range x (1 + RangeBonusPerStep x steps).
functions.BP_Extractor.GetMaxSources: UpgradedMaxSources once TotalMatterExtracted >= SecondSourceThreshold, else BaseMaxSources.
functions.BP_Extractor.GetInfoText1: HUD line 1: level, total extracted, matter to next bonus.
functions.BP_Extractor.PickSource: Chooses the nearest matter source within range, keeping the locked one if still valid and skipping Exclude.
functions.BP_Extractor.ShowBeam2: Shows the second beam to the second locked source (creating the component when needed).
functions.BP_Extractor.UpdateBeam1: Draws or hides the first beam depending on LockedSource.
functions.BP_Extractor.UpdateBeam2: Draws or hides the second beam depending on LockedSource2.
functions.BP_Extractor.PlaceBeam2: Positions and scales the second beam mesh.
functions.BP_Extractor.CreateBeam2: Creates the second beam static-mesh component using the first beam's mesh/material.
functions.BP_Extractor.MakeSoundComp: Creates a spatial audio component attached to the muzzle.
functions.BP_Extractor.UpdateExtractAudio: Loops extract.wav while the tool is in use with a locked source.
functions.BP_Constructor.OnRep_SelectedBuildable: Updates the tool name when the selection replicates.
functions.BP_Constructor.ComputePlacement: Traces from in front of the player to find a ground placement; returns location, yaw rotation and validity.
functions.BP_Constructor.SpawnBuildable: Spawns the buildable for an index (0 Barrier, 1 Turret).
functions.BP_Constructor.Build: Server: spawns the selected buildable, checks free space, pays its cost and keeps it (replicated) or destroys it.
functions.BP_Constructor.IsPlacementFree: Box overlap test that the target does not intersect pawns/dynamic actors.
functions.BP_Buildable.SetPreviewMode: Turns the actor into a ghost: marks preview, disables collision and applies the valid/invalid preview material.
functions.BP_Buildable.BuildableBeginPlay: Hook called from BeginPlay for children (empty here).
functions.BP_Turret.OnRep_ShotCounter: RepNotify of ShotCounter: plays the laser effect on clients.
functions.BP_Turret.TurretThink: Timer (0.1 s), server only: acquires a target and fires when the fire interval allows.
functions.BP_Turret.AcquireTarget: Keeps the current target while in range, otherwise finds the nearest monster.
functions.BP_Turret.FireAt: Applies Damages to the target, records the shot end point, increments ShotCounter and grants XP equal to the damage.
functions.BP_Turret.PlayLaser: Plays the laser Niagara effect toward LastShotEnd.
functions.BP_Turret.AimHead: Every tick: faces the label to the camera and rotates the head toward the target.
functions.BP_Turret.OnRep_currentLvl: Refreshes the label when the level replicates.
functions.BP_Turret.GainXp: Adds XP (below max level) and sets 'ready to upgrade' once the threshold (100/200/400/1000) is reached.
functions.BP_Turret.LevelUp: Applies the upgrade: +5 damage, +100 range, scale x UpgradeScaleFactor, next level threshold and price.
functions.BP_Turret.UpdateLabel: Builds the floating text (Lv N / MAX / E to upgrade + price) and refreshes the bar.
functions.BP_Turret.FaceLabel: Creates the label on first use and rotates it toward the local camera.
functions.BP_Turret.OnRep_bReadyToUpgrade: Refreshes the label when readiness replicates.
functions.BP_Turret.CanUpgrade: True if ready to upgrade, below max level and the player is within 300 uu.
functions.BP_Turret.TryUpgrade: Server: pays upgradePrice (via the character) and levels up.
functions.BP_Turret.OnRep_currentXp: Refreshes the label when XP replicates.
functions.BP_Turret.CreateLabel: Creates the text component and the 3D XP bar (background + fill).
functions.BP_Turret.UpdateBar: Scales/colours the XP bar fill (green, gold when ready/max).
functions.BP_MatterSource.OnRep_RemainingMatter: Updates the visual when remaining matter replicates.
functions.BP_MatterSource.InitMatter: Sets initial and remaining matter and refreshes the visual.
functions.BP_MatterSource.RemoveMatter: Removes up to Amount and returns what was taken; destroys the block when empty.
functions.BP_MatterSource.GetSurfaceDistance: Distance from a point to the block surface (centre distance minus block radius).
functions.BP_MatterSource.UpdateVisual: Scales the mesh with remaining matter and applies the BlockAll collision profile (camera ignored).
functions.BP_Ship.CanDeposit: True if the depositor is within the tank radius + DepositRange (XY distance).
functions.BP_Ship.DepositMatter: Adds matter to the tank; starts takeoff when MatterGoal is reached. Returns the amount accepted.
functions.BP_Ship.SpendMatter: Removes matter from the tank if enough is stored. Returns success.
functions.BP_Ship.GroundPoint: Line trace down from a point and returns the ground location (used to place the scout).
functions.BP_Ship.MakeSoundComp: Creates a spatial audio component on the ship.
functions.BP_Ship.PlaySiren: Starts the horde siren: plays hordeSiren.wav SirenRepeats times every SirenInterval seconds.
functions.BP_Ship.SirenTick: Plays one siren repetition and stops the timer when done.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.GetModeParams: Returns burst count, shots/s, speed, radius, damage, reload and cost for a mode.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.StartFire: Starts the laser (mode 3) or a burst (modes 1/2).
functions.BP_ShipTurret.TryStartBurst: Starts a burst if reloaded and idle; sets the burst timer.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.BurstTick: Timer callback: fires the next shell.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.FireShell: Pays the mode cost, spawns a BP_TurretShell at the muzzle (nozzle) along the pivot direction and launches it.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.EndBurst: Stops the burst timer and starts the reload.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.StartLaser: Activates the laser and starts LaserTick.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.LaserTick: Every 0.1 s: pays matter and damages monsters along the beam segment; stops when matter is missing.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.SpendFromShip: Pays from the owning ship's tank.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.AimAndDraw: Clamps pitch to [MinPitch, MaxPitch], rotates the pivot, places the muzzle NozzleForward in front, updates the laser beam and laser audio.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.GetStatusText: HUD text for the current mode / reload state.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.IsFree: True when nobody operates the turret.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.UpdateServerAim: Server: stores the operator's aim in the replicated AimRotation.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.UpdateVisualAim: Every machine: local operator uses their own aim, others use the replicated one.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.ComputeAim: Returns the operator's camera (control) rotation, i.e. the cannon looks where the camera looks.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.MakeSoundComp: Creates a spatial audio component attached to the muzzle.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.EnsureCannonAudio: Lazily creates the canon.wav component (multiple instances allowed).
functions.BP_ShipTurret.UpdateLaserAudio: Loops laser.wav while the laser is active.
functions.BP_ShipTurret.PlayCannon: Plays canon.wav once (called by each shell).
functions.BP_ScoutShip.Init: Server: stores the dock position, resets flight time and marks the scout as docked (called by BP_Ship).
functions.BP_ScoutShip.FlightTick: Server tick: with an operator, flies to the circular path and orbits it, burning matter; on request, no matter or empty flight time returns home, docks and recharges.
functions.BP_ScoutShip.RequestReturn: Asks the scout to return to the ship (E while flying).
functions.BP_ScoutShip.ClientSmooth: Clients: smooths the actor toward the replicated position + velocity.
functions.BP_ScoutShip.EnsureVisual: Builds the scout look once: hides the pedestal, lowers the gun and seat, adds a small hull from the ship mesh.
functions.BP_TurretShell.Launch: Sets damage/radius, ignores the firing actors and sets the projectile velocity in local space.
functions.BP_TurretShell.Explode: Server: applies area damage to monsters in Radius and destroys the shell.
functions.BP_TurretShell.PlayLaunchSound: Asks the owning turret to play the cannon sound.
functions.WBP_HUD.UpdateShipText: Updates ship tank/hull text and the mission status line.
functions.WBP_HUD.UpdateCharacterText: Updates health, matter, prompt, turret status and active tool name.
functions.WBP_HUD.UpdateWaveText: Updates the next-horde countdown or the remaining monster count.
functions.WBP_HUD.UpdateToolInfo: Shows the extractor's two info lines when it is equipped, clears them otherwise.
functions.WBP_MainMenu.RunCommand: Echoes and executes a console command (open map / join).
functions.WBP_Options.LoadSettings: Loads or creates the PlayerSettings save.
functions.WBP_Options.SaveControls: Saves the settings and tells the controller to reload them.
functions.WBP_Options.InitGraphicsState: Reads the current resolution, frame limit and window mode.
functions.WBP_Options.ApplyGraphics: Applies and saves non-resolution graphics settings.
functions.WBP_Options.LevelName: Quality level index to a name (Low..Cinematic).
functions.WBP_Options.Cycle: Changes the named setting by +/-1 and applies it.
functions.WBP_Options.ApplyDisplay: Applies and saves the resolution/window mode.
functions.WBP_Options.InitJetpackSelector: Shows the saved jetpack key in the key selector.

events.BP_PE_Character.SRV_JetpackOn: Run on Server RPC (reliable): activate jetpack.
events.BP_PE_Character.SRV_JetpackOff: Run on Server RPC (reliable): deactivate jetpack.
